_comment: How the skill outputs. Primary output is always the validated JSON-LD printed in chat as a ready-to-paste <script type="application/ld+json"> block. Additionally: save the raw .json into the Schema Markup Drive folder, and append a row to the tracking log Sheet (maintained by find-by-title -> read -> merge -> recreate, because this Workspace blocks in-place append). If the Drive connector is unavailable, fall back to writing the .json + a local CSV to the working dir and still print the chat block.
